posts.en:
dsh-memoria is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Vector + graph memory backend: observe/remember/search/recall tools against a local memoria server, fusing HNSW semantic recall, FTS5 keyword search, and knowledge-graph signals via RRF ranking, with automatic turn-end persistence and per-agent namespace isolation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-14f1535a3eabf79e2074.html
